title: Kula Today
heading: Today
summary: Cloudbase is lowering. Kula Ag had about half sun over the last hour; the cloud tops out between about 6,600 and 8,500 ft, with sun above it. Upslope has run since about 08:30 at a light 3 mph, and thermals seem light. Trades are holding the shear line at Pukalani, with no trade air on the lower west slope.
